# RealCold

RealCold is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. RealCold is a national cold chain and storage solutions company that offers flexible, multi-temperature storage and value added services to various industries such as food manufacturers, grocers, retailers, food service providers, and digital native brands. RealCold employs 98 people (+58.1% YoY, +36 people). Headquartered in Lakeland, Florida, United States.

## About

RealCold is a new kind of cold chain company, established to address shifting trends and volatile markets. With a growing network of modern warehouses, customer-centric engineering, and a focus on value-add services like direct-to-consumer, we are a strategic supply chain partner to food producers, manufacturers, food service providers, and retailers.

# Realcold NZ Ltd

Realcold NZ Ltd is a Wholesale company. Realcold NZ Ltd employs 37 people (-2.6% YoY, -1 person), founded in 1955. Headquartered in Auckland, Auckland, New Zealand, with presence in Australia.

## About

Realcold is a leading wholesale supplier to the refrigeration and air-conditioning industry in New Zealand. We specialise in refrigeration component wholesaling and are managed and operated by qualified, experienced refrigeration engineers.

 We understand the industry and your needs as a business owner or technician in the field. Our aim is to deliver the best solution to you; from engineering expertise and design on sophisticated applications, to selection of the correct part for a service call. Our experienced professionals will help you find the right answer, first time - every time.

We hope you find this site a useful tool for your business. If you can't find what you're looking for on our site, please contact our friendly Realcold team. We are here to help.

properties.description:
Realcold is a leading wholesale supplier to the refrigeration and air-conditioning industry in New Zealand. We specialise in refrigeration component wholesaling and are managed and operated by qualified, experienced refrigeration engineers.

 We understand the industry and your needs as a business owner or technician in the field. Our aim is to deliver the best solution to you; from engineering expertise and design on sophisticated applications, to selection of the correct part for a service call. Our experienced professionals will help you find the right answer, first time - every time.

We hope you find this site a useful tool for your business. If you can't find what you're looking for on our site, please contact our friendly Realcold team. We are here to help.

Realcold is a BEIJER REF company.
